documentation.LOW_POWER_MODE_MAX_CURRENT: Maximum value extracted from datatsheet (at 30°C, for correct PWR mode, MCU voltage, frequency and voltage scaling range)
documentation.LOW_POWER_MODE_MIN_CURRENT: Minimum value set to 75% of max value. This value is needed to avoid a passed test if IDD jumper is not removed
documentation.MCU_VOLTAGE: MCU nominal voltage for the test
documentation.MX_STATUS_LED_ACTIVE_STATE: GPIO state to turn on the LED
documentation.MX_STATUS_LED_INACTIVE_STATE: GPIO state to turn off the LED
